mkdir -p ~/workspace/asset_qa/out/a && python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
base=Path.home()/'workspace/asset_qa'
src=base/'source'; out=base/'out'/'a'; out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fontpath='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf'
font=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath, 34)
assets=[]
for source, name in [('a_banner_01.png','campaign_01.png'),('a_banner_02.png','campaign_02.png')]:
    im=Image.open(src/source).convert('RGB')
    # Both qualifying sources are exactly 16:9; scale to the deliverable dimensions.
    im=im.resize((1280,720), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA')
    # Legible, understated branded watermark in the lower-right corner.
    text='Q4 LAUNCH'
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    box=d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font, stroke_width=1)
    tw,th=box[2]-box[0],box[3]-box[1]
    pad_x,pad_y=19,12
    x=1280-tw-pad_x*2-32
    y=720-th-pad_y*2-28
    d.rounded_rectangle((x,y,x+tw+pad_x*2,y+th+pad_y*2), radius=7, fill=(0,0,0,145))
    d.text((x+pad_x,y+pad_y-box[1]),text,font=font,fill=(255,255,255,245),stroke_width=1,stroke_fill=(0,0,0,150))
    path=out/name
    im.convert('RGB').save(path,format='PNG', optimize=True)
    sha=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assets.append({'role':'A','source':source,'output':f'out/a/{name}','width':1280,'height':720,'watermark':'Q4 LAUNCH','status':'ready','sha256':sha})
excluded=[
 {'role':'A','source':'a_banner_broken.png','reason':'Corrupt; not a readable PNG image.'},
 {'role':'A','source':'a_banner_low.png','reason':'Undersized source (640 x 360).'},
 {'role':'A','source':'a_banner_square.png','reason':'Wrong source aspect ratio (1:1).'},
]
manifest={'schema':'bc12-asset-manifest/v1','revision':1,'assets':assets,'excluded':excluded}
(base/'asset_manifest.yaml').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
PY
curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18112/qa/A -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @~/workspace/asset_qa/asset_manifest.yaml
